    The Brand

    Delve into what we're all about

    At Equipped After Dark, it's all about being seen when you need it most. Our three core colours stand out but in harmony with the dark, paired with our staple reflective tech wear.

    Choose to be Equipped

    Our products are made with urban night life in mind. Be prepared for the weather with quality materials that are waterproof and highly reflective. Inspired by tech-wear, our design focus is on practicality, safety, and most of all, looking good while doing it.
